slides.title: Movers: when the building manager asks for your COI the day before the move, here's exactly what to say.

slides.myth: "I think we sent you one last year?"
slides.fact: "I'll send a current certificate today. What do you need listed on it?"

slides.myth: "Can we just do the move and send it after?"
slides.fact: "Let me get it from our agent now so nothing holds up the elevator."

slides.myth: "Don't worry, our insurance is definitely active."
slides.fact: "Let me check the policy dates and get right back to you."

slides.label: then
slides.title: actually read the expiration date before you hit send.
slides.body: a certificate that ended in October helps nobody on moving day.

slides.title: CertTrack tracks your insurance, licenses and permits for you.
slides.body: and alerts you before anything expires, not the night before a move.
